title: docker-test: test-in-docker.sh
description: Test script that runs committed project tests in a throwaway container: archives HEAD, runs npm ci and npm test, then deletes container.

steps.description: Header: shebang, comment, strict error handling.
Directory: cd to git root using rev-parse.
Pipeline: git archive HEAD piped to docker run with node:22-bookworm, which extracts, installs, tests.
